subject: chemistry
topic: Organic functional groups (alcohols, acids, esters) and polymers

kept.q: Which of the following functional groups is present in all alcohols (alkanols)?
kept.explanation: Alcohols are organic compounds whose molecules contain the hydroxyl group, -OH, attached to a carbon chain. The other groups belong to acids, aldehydes and esters respectively, not alcohols.
kept.pidgin: Alcohol na compound wey get -OH group for im molecule. The other groups na for acid, aldehyde and ester, no be alcohol.

kept.q: To which homologous series does ethanoic acid, CH3COOH, belong?
kept.explanation: Ethanoic acid contains the carboxyl group -COOH, which is the functional group that defines the alkanoic acid (carboxylic acid) homologous series. Alkanols have -OH and alkyl alkanoates (esters) have -COO-.
kept.pidgin: Ethanoic acid get -COOH group, na im be the mark for alkanoic acid family. Alkanol get -OH while ester (alkyl alkanoate) get -COO-.

kept.q: When ethanol reacts with ethanoic acid in the presence of a few drops of concentrated trioxosulphate(VI) acid as catalyst, the products formed are:
kept.explanation: This is esterification: an alcohol reacts with a carboxylic acid, with conc. H2SO4 as catalyst and dehydrating agent, to form an ester and water. Ethanol + ethanoic acid gives ethyl ethanoate (the ester) and water.
kept.pidgin: Dis na esterification: alcohol plus acid, wit conc. H2SO4 as catalyst, dey form ester and water. So ethanol plus ethanoic acid go give ethyl ethanoate and water.

kept.q: Which of the following compounds is an ester?
kept.explanation: Esters have the general functional group -COO- joining two carbon chains, as seen in CH3COOCH3 (methyl ethanoate). The other compounds are a carboxylic acid, an alcohol and an aldehyde respectively.
kept.pidgin: Ester get -COO- group wey dey join two carbon chain, like for CH3COOCH3 (methyl ethanoate). The other ones na acid, alcohol and aldehyde.

kept.q: Which of the following polymers is produced by condensation polymerisation, with a small molecule such as water lost during the reaction?
kept.explanation: Nylon is made by condensation polymerisation of a diamine and a dicarboxylic acid, with water eliminated as each bond forms. Polyethene, PVC and polystyrene are all addition polymers formed from alkene-type monomers with no by-product lost.
kept.pidgin: Nylon dey form from condensation polymerisation, wia diamine and diacid dey join and water dey comot. Polyethene, PVC and polystyrene na addition polymer, no by-product dey comot.

kept.q: A student prepares an ester by reacting methanoic acid with methanol. The product is methyl methanoate, HCOOCH3. What is the molar mass of this ester? [H=1, C=12, O=16]
kept.explanation: Methyl methanoate, HCOOCH3, has the formula C2H4O2. Molar mass = (2 x 12) + (4 x 1) + (2 x 16) = 24 + 4 + 32 = 60 g/mol.
kept.pidgin: Methyl methanoate, HCOOCH3, na C2H4O2. Molar mass = (2 x 12) + (4 x 1) + (2 x 16) = 24 + 4 + 32 = 60 g/mol.
